display_name: Resolution in the high southern latitudes, 1773-1774 (sample)
notes: Four points standing for a two-year track. It is a sample that proves the schema carries a line, not a route anyone may measure. The real track is compiled at ANT-5 from the journals.

A planned route is an intention, not an observation, and this drawing of it is ours. It is filed as editorial_interpolation so that no part of the pipeline can mistake it for evidence, which is the distinction Act VIII turns on.

display_name: Endurance in the ice, besetment to loss (two-point sample)
notes: Two endpoints joined by a straight line, which the drift certainly was not. Present only to prove the schema can hold a drift distinct from a planned route; ANT-9 replaces it with dated positions.
